text.ae2craftingtime.no_power.explanatio: The ME network can't power the next pattern dispatch.
text.ae2craftingtime.no_power.suggestion: Increase network power generation or stored energy.
text.ae2craftingtime.no_target.explanati: No usable destination was found for this pattern.
text.ae2craftingtime.no_target.suggestio: Connect a compatible machine or inventory to an enabled provider side.
text.ae2craftingtime.input_blocked.expla: The destination is not accepting this pattern's inputs.
text.ae2craftingtime.input_blocked.sugge: Check blocking mode, input space, filters, and machine sides.
text.ae2craftingtime.locked.explanation: Pattern Provider crafting locks are preventing the next batch.
text.ae2craftingtime.locked.suggestion: Check redstone conditions or return the previous result to its provider.
text.ae2craftingtime.dispatch_status.sch: This status applies to scheduled batches; active batches may still finish.
text.ae2craftingtime.chat.delayed.hint: Click to show the provider in the world
text.ae2craftingtime.locate_hint: Double-Click for highlighting Pattern Provider in a world
text.ae2craftingtime.sort.title: Sort by TTC
text.ae2craftingtime.stats.samples.expla: Effective throughput includes queueing and return transport. New samples arrive while crafting; the limit isn't the confidence threshold.
text.ae2craftingtime.no_provider.explana: No connected Pattern Provider currently offers this pattern.
text.ae2craftingtime.no_provider.suggest: Restore a connected provider or put the pattern back.
text.ae2craftingtime.no_space.explanatio: The ME network can't accept this item.
text.ae2craftingtime.no_space.suggestion: Free space in storage cells or add more storage.
